# Standen

> Standen designs and builds SaaS products for founders. Fixed scope, fixed price, live from 2 weeks. Founders own the source code, hosting and database. UK-based studio, founder-led by Tomas Jones.

## Main page
- [Home](https://www.standen.io/): SaaS for founders. First MVPs and larger product builds, with an agreed price, delivery plan and full ownership.
- [OhMyPod case study](https://www.standen.io/case-studies/ohmypod): 21-day podcast SaaS for Tom Sargent
